name: budongsan-tax
description: Calculate Korean real-estate taxes and check statutory conditions using explicit user-provided facts.

interface.longDescription: Budongsan Tax is a Korean real-estate tax calculator. It computes acquisition tax, property tax, comprehensive real-estate holding tax, capital gains tax on property sales, rental income tax, and gift and inheritance tax on real estate, and checks the statutory conditions behind them, such as household home count, one-home exemptions and reliefs. Every result shows the calculation steps and the Korean statute articles applied, and it can look up statutes, tax rulings and local tax ordinances from the national law database. Results depend on the facts the user supplies and the supported tax years. It does not file returns, access Hometax or other tax accounts, or replace review by a tax professional.
defaultPrompt: 부모에게 부동산을 증여받으면 어떤 정보가 필요해?
